title: [DocDB][LST] Packed columns: FATAL: Failed to write a batch with 0 operations into RocksDB: Corruption (yb/docdb/docdb_compaction_context.cc:265): Unable to pack old value for 50
body:
Jira Link: [DB-2767](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-2767)
### Description

With [LST](https://github.com/yugabyte/yb-long-system-test/) on my dev server I have run into this issue with packed columsn enabled.
On state 2e8c2fce3c6af3f967bf597ac2c44b004d9cf863 with 85ac8d87d99a214d99f6e701334b3162bfedc7e5 reverted locally (unrelated bug), I just still got a corruption:

I have shared the full yugabyte-data directory following this corruption for analysis.
